q1_issues.issue: The 2-cent rise is a change, but it is stored on the same "price" scale as the absolute closing price, so a price query returns 2 cents and 6.83 dollars as if they were comparable values.
The closing price is predicated of the closing event rather than of the shares, so nothing attaches a value to sk_shares_1.

q2_gaps: a measured CHANGE on an event ("rose 2 cents") — Measure records a level on an entity and there is no delta form distinguishing a change from a value
a price quoted at a moment ("closed at $6.83") — Measure has no time slot and no licensed way to attach the value to the shares through the closing event

whether a shared time or place adjunct distributes across coordinated VPs — Coordination & plurals states only that a shared subject carries over, yet the parse copies (Time ... (Weekday wednesday)) onto the second conjunct
notes: The group witness plus Possession for "Shares of Goodyear", the Patient on the non-volitional "rose", the Weekday term and the independently translated second conjunct all follow the instruction set. The measure slot is where it breaks down — a delta and a level share one "price" scale and both hang off event witnesses rather than the shares.
